mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CALENDAR SET CALENDAR_NAME = #{calendarName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, COLOR = #{color}, IS_DEFAULT = #{isDefault}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE TB_CALENDAR SET IS_DEFAULT = FALSE WHERE OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT e WHERE e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED') as EVENT_COUNT FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME WHERE c.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND c.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT c.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT e WHERE e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED') as EVENT_COUNT, CASE WHEN c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END as IS_SHARED, cs.SHARED_BY as SHARED_BY_USERNAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, cs.SHARE_TYPE as SHARE_TYPE FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs ON c.CALENDAR_ID = cs.CALENDAR_ID AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON cs.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE c.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR cs.CALENDAR_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL)

SELECT c.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT e WHERE e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED') as EVENT_COUNT, CASE WHEN c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END as IS_SHARED, cs.SHARED_BY as SHARED_BY_USERNAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, cs.SHARE_TYPE as SHARE_TYPE FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs ON c.CALENDAR_ID = cs.CALENDAR_ID AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON cs.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR cs.CALENDAR_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.IS_DEFAULT DESC, c.SORT_ORDER, c.CALENDAR_NAME

SELECT c.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT e WHERE e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED') as EVENT_COUNT, FALSE as IS_SHARED, NULL as SHARED_BY_USERNAME, NULL as SHARED_BY_NAME, NULL as SHARE_TYPE FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME WHERE c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY c.IS_DEFAULT DESC, c.SORT_ORDER, c.CALENDAR_NAME

SELECT c.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT e WHERE e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED') as EVENT_COUNT FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME WHERE c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} AND c.IS_DEFAULT = TRUE AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT WHERE CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
SELECT MAX(SORT_ORDER) FROM TB_CALENDAR WHERE OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs ON c.CALENDAR_ID = cs.CALENDAR_ID AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE c.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR cs.CALENDAR_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL)

SELECT CASE WHEN c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE cs.SHARE_TYPE END FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs ON c.CALENDAR_ID = cs.CALENDAR_ID AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE c.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR cs.CALENDAR_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL)
